content:
The dynamic online shoe market

The online shoe sales sector has experienced remarkable growth over the past several years. En 2022, the French online shoe market Has reached 13.1 billion euros, an increase of more than 42% compared to 2014. This expansion can be explained both by the emergence of Pure Players suchlike Zalando, Sarenza or Spartoo, but also by the digitalization of physical signs who are now developing their own E-shops.

Les French consumers are among the biggest shoe buyers in Europe, just behind the British. On average, A French person buys 6.2 pairs of shoes per year, for a annual budget of around €380 per household.

The importance of quality visuals for online sales

The initial reluctance of online shoppers to order shoes, often linked to concerns about size, comfort, or visual appearance, has largely faded away. E-retailers have been able to respond to these challenges by enriching the shopping experience thanks to ever more comprehensive visual content:

  • High resolution 2D visuals
  • Multi-angle photographs
  • Interactive 360° views
  • 3D animations
  • Interactive size guides

These visual elements, coupled with policies of fast delivery and returns (often free), allow e-retailers to Remove the last obstacles to buying and to significantly improve their conversion rate.

Producing visuals internally: a strategic asset

Internalizing the production of visuals is now a strategic option for shoe brands. This approach allows reduce the time it takes to put it online, of control costs and to offer a visual coherence across the entire product catalog.

A growing demand for realism and detail

In the footwear sector, the fidelity of colors, materials and volumes is essential. Buyers want to be able zoom in on the stitching, the finishes, the soles, and get a true overview of the product as if they had it in their hands. Suggest seen from every angle is no longer a differentiating advantage: it has become a switchboard.
It is for this reason that the solutions of automated photography offered by Orbitvu are now becoming a key tool in the content strategy of shoe brands.

La Shoe photography to put them online is feasible and even recommended internally. In France, the online market represented 9.2 billion euros in 2014. With an increase of more than 5% since 2010, it is a sector in full expansion.

The online shoe boom

It now has recent pure players (such as Zalando or Zappos) as well as physical stores now offering their own e-shops.
In fact, online sales represent 11% of shoe market by value ; the French are also among the largest European buyers just behind the United States: around 5.7 pairs are purchased per year, representing a portfolio of €330 per household every year.

faqs.question: How to save time in creating product visuals?
faqs.answer: The key lies in automating the most time-consuming steps: shooting, framing, lighting, clipping and exporting. With an automated studio, it is possible to produce a complete series of multi-angle images or a 360° view in less than five minutes. Batch capture and batch processing capabilities make it possible to manage multiple models in series, while reducing time to go online.

faqs.question: Does automation limit creativity?
faqs.answer: It is a received idea. By removing technical constraints, automation instead frees up time and space to focus on artistic direction. The user can experiment with lights, backgrounds, or visual effects without having to worry about basic settings. The studio is becoming a tool for creativity, not a limit.

faqs.question: What types of content can you produce with a single solution?
faqs.answer: A single studio makes it possible to generate high-definition 2D photos, multi-angle presentations, multi-angle presentations, interactive 360° views or even 3D animations that can be used on a website, mobile or social networks. All from a unified interface, without having to go through several providers or software tools.

faqs.question: Can production really be internalized without expertise in photography?
faqs.answer: Yes. The solutions are designed to be used without extensive technical training. The interface is intuitive and the settings are assisted. All you have to do is follow the steps proposed to obtain a professional result. This allows an e-commerce, marketing or product team to manage the shots themselves, even without a dedicated photographer.

faqs.question: How to guarantee a faithful rendering of colors and materials?
faqs.answer: Visual fidelity is ensured by complete control of the shooting environment. The LED light sources are calibrated, the color temperature is constant, and the settings are repeatable. This is what makes it possible to accurately reproduce the textures specific to shoes such as leather, suede, or technical materials.
